The ad offers two rooms of the apartment and the coded $895 is one room's price; ads 2470016, 2509319 and 2562803 for the same unit ask $2,895 to $3,275 for the whole apartment.

evidence.quote: Contact for additional rates and lease terms.

evidence.detail: The $9,999 ask is a placeholder: ad 3549946 for the same studio, five months earlier with the same description, asks $3,190, and this ad defers the real rate to a contact.

Listing 4283761 text: "Starting at $4126". The $14,399 ask is about three and a half times ad 4283761 for the same one-bedroom with the same description three months later, which asks $4,126 and states "Starting at $4126". A starting rate backs no exact set, so the row is excluded.
